message.text: Checking idp_service and auth_service_sso to verify whether OIDC or SAML implementations exist elsewhere.

idp.go contains only the IdentityProviderUserInfo struct. The provider abstraction interface has not yet been located.

The oauth2 package defines the IdentityProvider struct with ExchangeToken and UserInfo methods. Now checking auth_service.go for provider type selection logic.

The abstraction package is `internal/idp`, defined in `idp.go`.

The implementation package is `internal/idp/oauth2`. It is the only concrete protocol implementation shipped. No OIDC or SAML packages exist under `internal/idp`.

h03.
**internal/idp**; **internal/idp/oauth2**

The provider abstraction lives in `internal/idp/idp.go`, which defines the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type used across SSO flows:

```1:8:internal/idp/idp.go
package idp

type IdentityProviderUserInfo struct {
	Identifier  string
	DisplayName string
	Email       string
	AvatarURL   string
}
```

The only shipped concrete protocol implementation is OAuth2 in `internal/idp/oauth2`. That package provides `IdentityProvider` with `ExchangeToken` and `UserInfo`, and is wired in at login time when the stored provider type is `OAUTH2`:

```1:2:internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go
// Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration.
package oauth2
```

```119:134:server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go
	var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
	if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
		oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
		// ...
		token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
		// ...
		userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
```

Under `internal/idp/`, only `idp.go` and the `oauth2/` subdirectory exist — no other protocol implementations ship in this repository.
